integrity: Analytic inequality and both limiting constructions supplied; tests are finite sanity checks, not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: No classification of all limiting optimizers, no quantitative rate, no general graph or other Lp norm extension; historical priority subject to independent verification.
scientific_scope: Compact metric stars with at least three positive edges, fixed total length, Dirichlet leaves, Kirchhoff center, unweighted Poisson resolvent in L-infinity.
title: An unattained sharp minimax law for Dirichlet-star Poisson resolvents
